alerts.title: Night gathering ban in central Paris
alerts.body: Adult curfew at Republique ended Tue Oct 27 6am. Undeclared gatherings banned 8pm-6am, and a 9pm-6am curfew for unaccompanied minors, through Thu Oct 29 6am near the Elysee, Assemblee nationale, Senate, Champs-Elysees, Vendome, Chatelet, Republique, Bastille and main rail stations. Extensions possible.

alerts.title: US Embassy security alert
alerts.body: Violent protests and rioting may continue. Avoid demonstrations, crowds and police activity; check curfew notices, RATP and SNCF updates. US advisory Level 2.

alerts.title: Yellow vest protests
alerts.body: Pot-banging protest Fri Oct 30 and Acte III sit-in Sat Oct 31 at the Assemblee nationale, plus local actions.

alerts.title: Student march
alerts.body: High school and university students march from the Pantheon at 2pm toward the Medef headquarters. Recent student marches saw clashes.

alerts.title: National union strike day
alerts.body: Intersyndicale strike and march day. All four SNCF rail unions call a strike (mainline, regional and RER trains). No specific RATP metro notice yet. Rail plan due the evening before. Paris march route TBA.

alerts.title: National retirees' march
alerts.body: Rally 11am at Gare Montparnasse, march to Les Invalides at 1pm.
